statement: Build a one-page, phone-friendly website for Brew Lab, a small specialty coffee shop in Indiranagar, Bengaluru, where visitors see the menu with prices, the opening hours and the shop address, and can pre-order a coffee for pickup without paying online.
audience: Coffee lovers and office staff near the shop in Indiranagar, Bengaluru
standards: Works on phones and on desktop
No payment taken on the site
Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript in one file, no build step
rules: Show only facts given by the Requester, copied exactly
Show the written address only, no embedded map
Pre-orders are sent by email to hello@brewlab.example
No payment on the site; customers pay at pickup
done_when: The page shows the name Brew Lab and the address 12, 100 Feet Road, Indiranagar, Bengaluru 560038 as text, with no embedded map
The page shows the menu with all seven items and their prices: Filter coffee 90, Cappuccino 160, Latte 180, Cold brew 200, Masala chai 80, Almond croissant 140, Banana bread slice 120
The page shows the opening hours: Monday to Saturday 7:30 am to 9:00 pm, Sunday 8:30 am to 6:00 pm, with no closed days
The page shows the phone +91 98450 12345 and the email hello@brewlab.example
The page has a pre-order form with the fields name, phone, items and pickup time, and it sends the order to hello@brewlab.example
The page states that there is no online payment and customers pay at pickup, and has no payment field
The site is a single page that works on phones: no horizontal overflow at 360px and 1280px, and no broken in-page link
The page has no JavaScript errors, no horizontal overflow at 360px and 1280px, and every in-page link points to an existing section.
visitor_needs: Contact the shop by phone or email
